subject: POC success criteria, timeline and eval route for InsightLane
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Maya Chen <maya@insightlane.com>, InsightLane Eng Team <eng-team@insightlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: POC success criteria and evaluation route for InsightLane

Hi Maya / Team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on the high-level goal (reduce manual tagging time for search relevance by 60% while keeping precision > 92%). I promised to put a short, concrete plan on paper so we can lock owners and next steps.

Proposal (high level):
- Success criteria (pass/fail):
  - Functionality: Redwood integrates with your ingestion pipeline and serves predictions for 95%+ of target doc types.
  - Quality: 3-week shadow run shows P@10 improves by >= 8 percentage points vs baseline and precision @K >= 92%.
  - Performance & stability: median 95th-percentile latency < 350ms for 512 token canonical requests during shadow window; no more than 0.5% error rate.
  - Privacy/compliance: redacted PII end-to-end, review of KMS integration completed.

- Eval methodology options (we should pick one):
  1) Online shadowing (preferred for most customers): Redwood receives live traffic, stores predictions, no customer-facing changes. We compare predictions against your relevance labels / human judgments.
  2) Offline batch evaluation: We run a curated sample of queries offline; faster and lower ops, but less coverage of edge-case flows.

- Recommended: 2-week shadow window (optionally preceded by a 1-week pilot integration), sampleing plan: 50k queries/day (or equivalent traffic slice), retaining a random 10% for human review + targeted high-variance buckets.

- Timeline (target):
  - Week 0: SOW + data access + security checklist (1 week), sign-off on eval rubric (this doc attached).
  - Week 1: Integration + smoke tests (Redwood + InsightLane Eng).
  - Week 2-3: Shadow run and automated collection.
  - Week 4: Scoring, handoff, decision meeting.

Ownership (proposed):
- InsightLane eng: data access + sandbox routing (owner: Maya).
- Redwood CS (day-to-day ops + triage): Marissa Cole.
- Redwood Success (metrics, acceptance gating): Karthik Iyer.
- Account exec (commercial): Vanessa Ortiz (billing/contract).

Open items I need from you to lock the plan:
1) Preference: shadowing vs offline batch? Any constraints that force offline?
2) Confirmation of dataset location, expected daily query volume, and any sensitive document classes we should exclude.
3) Target decision date window (we proposed end of Week 4 above).

Attachments: eval_rubric_v1.xlsx (grading rubric + proposed thresholds), InsightLane_SOW_draft.pdf (commercial stub).

If that looks reasonable I'll update the rubric based on your feedback and we can ship a short SOW for signature.

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1-415-555-0123

From: Maya Chen <maya@insightlane.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: InsightLane Eng Team <eng-team@insightlane.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC success criteria and evaluation route for InsightLane

On Thu, Oct 14, 2026 at 9:20 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on the high-level goal...

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the very clear note. High level we like the approach and prefer shadowing, with a couple of adjustments:

- Privacy: we need explicit handling for documents tagged as "confidential" — please confirm Redwood will drop those predictions from logs or redact before storage.
- Thresholds: rather than a single P@10 delta target, could we add a secondary quality gate around recall for low-frequency queries (bottom 5% by volume)? We want to avoid regressions in tail coverage.
- Sample size: 50k/day seems fine but can we start smaller for the first 48 hours (10k/day) just to validate routing, then ramp to full volume?

Can we schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to confirm data access path + checklist? My eng lead (cc'd: eng-team@insightlane.com) will join.

Maya
Head of Search Product
InsightLane
maya@insightlane.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Maya Chen <maya@insightlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC success criteria and evaluation route for InsightLane

Thanks Maya — sounds good and totally reasonable. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Privacy: confirmed — Redwood will redact PII/"confidential" flagged docs before persisting any prediction data and we'll share the redaction policy for your security review. KMS integration is on the SOW checklist.
- Quality gates: we'll add the low-frequency recall gate to the rubric (bottom 5% tail recall >= baseline - 3 pts).
- Ramp plan: agree — 48-hrs smoke at 10k/day, ramp to 50k/day pending smoke results.

Action items I'm taking now:
- Marissa: please run through the rubric and produce v2 with the low-frequency gate + an explicit pass/fail decision matrix (owner: Marissa).
- Karthik: please draft the metric dashboard template we'll use for the Week 4 decision call (owner: Karthik).
- Vanessa: I'll send the SOW and short commercial note for approval (owner: Vanessa).

Proposed quick sync: 2026-10-15T10:00AM PT (30m) — Maya + InsightLane eng + Marissa + Karthik. Let me know if that works.

Cheers,
Evelyn

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Maya Chen <maya@insightlane.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-16T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Updated eval rubric and decision matrix (v2)

Forwarding updated rubric after our internal review — attached: eval_rubric_v2.xlsx (contains explicit pass/fail cells and the tail-recall gate). Highlights:

- Scoring buckets: automated score (0-100) broken into Accept / Review / Reject with thresholds.
- Pass/fail matrix: requires all critical gates (precision, tail-recall, latency) to be green to pass. One mitigated failure allowed if a documented remediation plan is attached.
- Data exclusions: any doc with tags (confidential, legal-hold) will be excluded from analysis by default; we will share the exclusion list.
- Smoke/ramp: we will capture first 48h smoke at 10k/day; ramp to 50k/day over 2 business days.

Attachments: eval_rubric_v2.xlsx (new), InsightLane_SOW_draft.pdf (updated with KMS clause). Please review and I'll incorporate feedback before we send the SOW to legal.

Thanks — Marissa
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
